parameters.note: Rocky Wash is not named in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it follows the general statewide stream regulation §5.85(a)(2): open all year, with a 5-trout harvest season from the last Saturday in April through Nov. 15 and a 0-trout, artificial-lures-with-barbless-hooks catch-and-release season from Nov. 16 through the Friday before the last Saturday in April. Rocky Wash is a short (~0.3 mi) tributary that enters the Truckee River — Lake Tahoe's outlet — between Tahoe City and Truckee (Placer Co.). The Truckee River special regulation §7.50(b)(154) applies only to named main-stem reaches of the river itself and contains no 'and tributaries' clause; moreover Rocky Wash's confluence lies in the general-regulation stretch of the Truckee (downstream of the closed 1,000-ft outlet-dam zone in 154(A) and upstream of the Trout Creek confluence where 154(B) begins), so no special Truckee reg reaches this tributary. Rocky Wash appears to be a minor, likely intermittent drainage; no current stocking or documented trout fishery was found for it. Species left empty as no source names fish in it.

candidates.summary: Open all year under the general statewide stream regulation: harvest season (last Saturday in April through Nov. 15, 5 trout) and a zero-trout catch-and-release season (Nov. 16 through the Friday before the last Saturday in April, artificial lures with barbless hooks only). This unlisted Truckee River tributary is not covered by the Truckee River main-stem special reg.
